postconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10000 inclusive.
For each test case, the number of queries n is between 1 and 200000 inclusive.
The base k is always 2 for all test cases.

invariants.description: Each query y is a decimal number between 0 and 2 * 10^7 inclusive.
The response r is a decimal number between 0 and 2 * 10^7 inclusive.
The response r is not -1, indicating an invalid query.
